title: Dynamic Island
say: Your desktop deserves a Dynamic Island.

title: Lives on the edge of your screen
say: It lives on the edge of your screen, or up top, like on your phone.

title: Now Playing
say: Your music, with album art and controls.

title: Reply without switching apps
say: Messages and mail pop up, and you reply right there.

title: Claude Code, live
say: Every Claude Code session in your terminals, live, with exactly what it changed.

title: Every change, file by file
say: And the Sessions tab keeps every change, file by file.

title: Approve from anywhere
say: Allow or deny its requests from any app.

title: Drag actions
say: Drag any file and hold still. Convert it, shrink it, or ask Claude about it, right where you are.

title: An assistant that asks first
say: An AI assistant with a face, that asks before it acts.

title: Your documents
say: It fixes your documents, as tracked changes you can review.

title: A little character
say: And a little character that keeps you company.

title: Free and open source
say: Free and open source. Get it on GitHub.
